"Pro-drop in Dinka is restricted to clause-initial position and exclusively targets 3rd person DPs, giving rise to a partial pro-drop pattern of sorts. It may seem initially plausible to link this to the fact that only 3rd person DPs trigger overt agreement, but this cannot be the full story. There are clauses in which no overt agreement is found for 3rd person DPs (interrogative clauses, for example). In such environments, the same partial pro-drop pattern is found."
